the integration of passenger information in the dispatching process can reduce waiting times significantly.
passenger information and dispatching strategies can be used to achieve a reduction of passenger waiting times and that this is possible even with simple dispatching strategies.
the integration of passenger information into dispatching strategies can reduce the average waiting time of passengers by about 20%.

the development of decision support tools for customer-oriented dispatching in the German railway network, which is a complex system of about 6000 km of tracks and 30000 trains per day.
a more customer-oriented dispatching, where passengers are treated as a resource and not only as an obstacle.
a better understanding of passenger preferences and their integration into dispatching algorithms.

the simulation-based decision support tools can improve the dispatching process.
customer oriented dispatching can improve the timeliness of the rail traffic.
the use of passenger preferences in the dispatching process can be beneficial.

the integration of passengers into dispatching strategies can be done by means of decision support tools.
